description.zh-CN: 股票行情软件风格的 Komari 主题：报价表式节点列表与 K 线式资源趋势
description.en: A stock-terminal style theme for Komari: quote-board node list and candlestick resource charts

help.zh-CN: 首页报价表的板块划分。大洲按节点地区自动归类；后台分组使用节点设置中的「分组」字段；不分组则平铺。涨跌配色、走势曲线、刷新间隔等展示偏好由访客在首页「设置」中自行调整。
help.en: How the home board is split into sections. Continent groups nodes by region; Admin group uses each node's Group field; None lists them flat. Display preferences such as up/down colors, trails and refresh rate are set by each visitor from the Settings button on the home page.
